title: helm-private-values-init-hooks-kms-nodeselector-upgrade-rollback-fix
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Fixes nodeselector handling for KMS init hooks and improves upgrade/rollback compatibility for redwood-private Helm chart. No API changes; config migration notes provided.
description: Motivation: Recent private deploys hit a regression during chart upgrades when KMS init hooks applied nodeselector semantics inconsistently between install and upgrade paths. This caused initjobs to schedule to incorrect nodes or fail on air-gapped clusters with strict node selectors. This PR stabilizes values.schema and templates for the private Helm chart so KMS-related init hooks respect 'kms.nodeSelector' and 'kms.tolerations' consistently across fresh installs, upgrades, and rollbacks. Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json: add explicit top-level `kms.nodeSelector` and `kms.tolerations` entries and mark defaults as nullable with clear upgrade notes; 2) templates/initjobs/kms-initjob.yaml: read nodeSelector + tolerations via include helper and fall back to legacy `private.kmsNodeSelector` for backward compatibility; 3) templates/_helpers.tpl: add helpers for safe merging of node selectors and tolerations, and add a debug annotation when `--debug` is enabled; 4) hooks/pre-upgrade-kms.yaml and hooks/post-rollback-kms.yaml: add idempotency guards, exponential backoff annotations and improved cleanup logic to prevent orphaned initjobs after interrupted upgrades; 5) Chart.yaml and NOTES.txt: document migration steps and known limitations. Checklist: - [x] values schema updated and unit-tested with schema-lint harness - [x] template helpers added and locally linted with helm template - [x] e2e upgrade/rollback scenario tested on k3s and EKS (air-gapped simulation) - [x] reviewers addressed comments and tests passing in CI Impact: Admins who previously set `private.kmsNodeSelector` should be unaffected; new preferred fields are `kms.nodeSelector` and `kms.tolerations`. Migration steps are non-destructive but recommended to be applied to values.yaml prior to large fleet upgrades. See `migration_steps` field for instructions.
commit_summary: 3 commits: normalize KMS nodeselector schema (values.schema.json), add helper templates + initjob template fixes, add upgrade/rollback hook idempotency and docs.
review_thread:
Evan: Reported that initjob would sometimes schedule to control-plane nodes in our k3s reproducible case. Suggested adding a helper merge to prefer explicit kms.nodeSelector over legacy keys.
Priya: Implemented a helper that merges selectors and falls back safely; added unit tests.
Marina: Requested idempotency around hooks and better cleanup on rollback; found a race when pre-upgrade hook succeeded but post-rollback failed.
Priya: Added exponential backoff + cleanup annotations and a post-rollback hook to ensure orphaned jobs removed.
Jordan: Verified EKS air-gapped simulation succeeds and approved.
Final: 3 approvals, minor CI flake rerun resolved.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge on 2026-02-25 after 3 approvals and all CI checks passing. Merge commit contains consolidated change notes and migration pointers.
changelog_entry: Fix: stabilize KMS init hook nodeSelector/tolerations handling across install/upgrade/rollback (redwood-private Helm chart).
migration_steps: 1) If you set legacy `private.kmsNodeSelector` in your values, add equivalent keys under `kms.nodeSelector` and set both during a transition window. 2) Run `helm upgrade --install --reuse-values` against a single cluster to validate. 3) Monitor initjob logs: `kubectl -n redwood get jobs -l app=redwood-kms-init` then `kubectl logs job/<job-name>`. 4) After fleet validated, remove legacy `private.kmsNodeSelector` from values. 5) For air-gapped installs, ensure chart has access to the initjob image; use preloaded images or private registry settings as before.
notes_for_ops: This change is low-risk but touched hooks; recommend scheduling upgrades during low-traffic windows. If you see initjob pods stuck in Pending, verify cluster node labels match `kms.nodeSelector` and tolerations permit scheduling. The new helpers will annotate debug info when Helm is run with --debug which aids troubleshooting.
backport_plan: No backports planned; patch release will include this change in the next 0.11.x chart patch if any regressions are reported.
